propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before first use, creating friction compared to non-deferred tools
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is a global all-or-nothing control with no per-tool or per-server granularity; the original plan's assumption of per-tool deferral settings does not match the actual implementation
Loading all Serena schemas (approximately 25 tools) costs a floor of 25,454 additional tokens in a minimal environment, scaling to 63,852 tokens across a typical 4-server MCP setup
A tracked .claude/settings.json file must be created with a .gitignore negation to allow configuration persistence while keeping .claude/ otherwise ignored
The measured context cost and justification for the chosen ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH value must be documented to support future decisions about the token budget tradeoff
